label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Some good news I’ve been looking forward to sharing: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November.

Priya is a chartered structural engineer with IStructE and brings nine years’ experience at a consultancy in Coventry. Having her on board will make a real difference to how quickly we can get your calculations and drawings back to you. If she comes out to your home, please say hello and help us make her welcome.

There’s also something I need to put right. During September and October, our turnaround for beam calculations and drawings slipped to five or six weeks. Several clients waited far too long, and some were understandably unhappy. The criticism we received, including a sharp review, was deserved.

Those slow weeks were my fault. I said yes to more work than I could manage alone. I was out on site during the day and doing calculations until midnight, but working longer wasn’t fixing the problem.

One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting and their steel already ordered. We got their calculations to them in three days once things came to a head, but only after they’d chased twice. They shouldn’t have needed to.

With Priya joining, our new target for beam calculations and drawings is **10 working days**. That’s a target we need to earn your confidence in, not just announce. If you’re waiting now, your job is moving forward, and you can message me directly for an update.

One other change: **first site visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95**, deducted from your fee if you go ahead with us. Around a third of free visits haven’t become jobs, and we need to make that time sustainable.

**Any visit already booked when this post is published stays free, whatever its date.**

I’m genuinely delighted to welcome Priya. Thank you to everyone who’s trusted us with their wall removals and loft conversions—and to those who’ve been patient when we’ve fallen short.
